Triage first-touch — concentrated round #2 (triage seat, session `session_019ZyCHcjXeTFPiS8RWRk4nN`, 2026-08-19): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` · Task. **Route (a), inheriting the #4580 ruling with its reason intact** ("re-export, not restate — a structural copy would reproduce the defect the moment either side moved"): `ComponentInput` is the next instance of the exact shape that ruling was written for, already exhibiting a dormant divergence (`min`/`max`/`step`/`placeholder` missing from the copy registration actually imports, while the zod schema and `ComponentMeta.inputs` accept them). Core re-exports from types the same way `core/src/types/index.ts:41` already handles `SchemaNode`; `plugin-scope.ts`'s copy converges too. Implementation obligations carried from the ruling's own precedent: measure the core `dist/index.d.ts` delta before landing (the #4580 land was justified by a measured byte-identical dist), and report — not silently absorb — any registration that newly type-errors. **`WidgetInput` union-arm capability is explicitly out of scope** (different gate path, separate judgment, per the body). Size/model suggestion: M, opus.

Claim: PM loop round 13
Session: `session_012u2pRjcqAYtoEjgr3wwhnK`
Branch: `claude/issue-4972-componentinput-reexport`
Domain: `domain:ui` (execution seat)

**Thread read before dispatch.** Triage adjudicated this on 2026-08-19 as **route (a), inheriting #4580's ruling with its reason intact**:

> *"re-export, not restate — a structural copy would reproduce the defect the moment either side moved"*

`ComponentInput` is the next instance of the shape that ruling was written for, and it is **already diverging**: `min` / `max` / `step` / `placeholder` are missing from the copy that registration actually imports, while the zod schema and `ComponentMeta.inputs` accept them. Core re-exports from types the same way `core/src/types/index.ts:41` already handles `SchemaNode`; `plugin-scope.ts`'s copy converges too.

**Three implementation obligations carried from #4580's own precedent — these are the ruling, not my additions:**
1. ⛔ **Measure the core `dist/index.d.ts` delta before landing.** The #4580 land was justified by a *measured* byte-identical dist. Clear `dist/` **and** `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` on both legs (composite `tsc` skips emit if the build info survives, and it often lives outside `dist/`), and compare by **hash**, not byte count.
2. ⛔ **Report — do not silently absorb — any registration that newly type-errors.** Converging a copy that was quietly narrower will surface real call sites. Each one is a finding, not a cleanup.
3. ⛔ **`WidgetInput`'s union-arm capability is explicitly OUT of scope** — different gate path, separate judgment, per the card body.

**Clause ②:** a re-export that leaves `dist/index.d.ts` byte-identical widens nothing, which is exactly why obligation 1 is the gate rather than a nicety. If the delta is **not** byte-identical, that is a published-surface change: stop and report with the measurement rather than landing it.

⛔ OUT: `packages/data-objectstack/**` (#5024 this round), `packages/components/**` + `packages/react-runtime/**` + `content/docs/**` (#5469), `packages/plugin-calendar/**` (#5045). ⚠️ `packages/types/src/complex.ts` and the date-range vocabulary are **#4984's** surface this round — if your convergence reaches them, report rather than edit.

## Closing — route (a) landed in #5671 (merged `b2b3d1ec1` → `main`, 08:33Z)

Closed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (session `session_012u2pRjcqAYtoEjgr3wwhnK`) rather than by the PR's closer: #5671 was deliberately opened as `Part of`, not `Fixes`, because it carried an open governance question. That was the right default — a merge could not silently close a card still under adjudication. The question is now ruled, so the close is explicit.

### What landed

`ComponentInput`'s three structural copies are converged onto the single declaration in `@object-ui/types`' `base.ts`. Both copies (`core/src/registry/Registry.ts`, `types/src/plugin-scope.ts`) are now re-exports.

The divergence was confirmed **three-way**, not two — verified independently against `origin/main` during review:

| declaration | keys |
|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/base.ts:379` | **13** |
| `packages/types/src/plugin-scope.ts:177` | 9 |
| `packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts:24` | 9 |

Set difference in both directions is exactly `min`, `max`, `step`, `placeholder` — and `zod/base.zod.ts`'s `ComponentInputSchema` declares all four. So the **publication** face advertised four keys the **authoring** face rejected. No registration had written one yet, so nothing a user hits was broken.

### The gate question, ruled **A**

The dispatch obligation named `core/dist/index.d.ts` byte-identity as the clause-② gauge. It came back byte-identical — and that certifies nothing. `packages/core/src/index.ts` names `ComponentInput` **zero times** (95 lines, `export *` throughout bar two named exports), so that file is byte-identical under *any* change to a re-exported module. A control leg adding a **required** key confirmed it: the barrel did not move while `Registry.d.ts` did.

A clause discharged by a gauge that cannot fail was never discharged, in either direction. What clause ② protects — *nothing widened beyond what was ruled* — was instead established directly: 9 → 13 resolved properties through the TypeScript checker, delta enumerated as exactly the four adjudicated keys, declaration home collapsed to one site, all 40 type-checkable packages green, zero newly-erroring registrations.

### Carved out, so it is not lost with this card

This card's body deferred the `WidgetInput` union-arm judgment — 「建议单独判」 — and that deferral existed **only here**. It is now **#5675**, filed before this close specifically so it would survive it. Confirmed on `main`: `WidgetInput.type` restates 11 literals inline where `ComponentInput` uses `ComponentInputControlType`, and spells the enum-options slot `options?` against `ComponentInput`'s `enum?`.

Two further findings surfaced by the same work:

- **#5673** — #4580's own "`dist/index.d.ts` is byte-identical" justification is the same vacuous measurement, written into `packages/core/src/types/index.ts` as evidence. It is what put the gauge into this card's obligation, so it has now propagated twice.
- **#5674** — `PluginComponentInput` has zero consumers repo-wide (exactly one occurrence: the alias itself at `types/src/index.ts:912`); after #5671 it is a pure alias of `ComponentInput`.

Closing as completed.
